name: Paraluni MasterChef depositByAddLiquidity unvalidated tokens

classification.summary: MasterChef.depositByAddLiquidity() accepted caller-supplied token addresses without checking them against the pool's configured LP pair, so an attacker-written token re-entered the same function from its transferFrom hook and was credited a deposit position that was never funded, which was then withdrawn as real USDT/BUSD.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

lastCodeChange.description: 2021-12-21T02:56:38Z (BSC block 13657442): ParaProxy implementation (storage slot 2) changed 0x905072738158b5e74251c82e6165b62f3eb513a5 -> 0xa386f30853a7eb7e6a25ec8389337a5c6973421d, found by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on slot 2 and corroborated by the proxy's own NewImplementation(address,address) event in the same block

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/paraluni.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: MasterChef 0x633fa755a83b015cccdc451f82c57ea0bd32b4b4 created 2021-12-13 by 0xd5c0bd4a6f30824e13b15282d431063bd01bd7d0 (Paraluni deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0x94bc1d555e63eea23fe7fdbf937ef3f9ac5fcf8f; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events before the incident (this proxy does not emit them - see the recheck below). Recheck (deployment basis was wrong): the victim is a ParaProxy (verified source; ParaProxyAdminStorage puts admin at slot 0, pendingAdmin 1, implementation 2, pendingImplementation 3) whose fallback delegatecalls `implementation`. Its own 1,339-byte runtime never changed (identical keccak(eth_getCode) at creation block 13431009 and incident block 16008281), but binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on slot 2 over [13431009, 16008280] shows two installs: 0x905072738158b5e74251c82e6165b62f3eb513a5 at block 13431092 (2021-12-13T05:36:13Z) and 0xa386f30853a7eb7e6a25ec8389337a5c6973421d at block 13657442 (2021-12-21T02:56:38Z); the second is the only address delegatecalled by the victim in the exploit trace (selectors 1526fe27/5029d25f/ff09731b/e2bbb158/93f1a40b/441a3e70, including depositByAddLiquidity). Both writes are mirrored by NewImplementation events on the proxy, of which there are exactly two. Age measured from the second install: 81.9 days rather than the 89.8 days the deployment basis gave.

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/paraluni.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
